_comment: FAQ 更新日志（人工维护）。按 date 倒序展示；speciesId 可选，用于链接到鸟种详情。日期格式 YYYY-MM-DD。

entries.titleZh: 白骨顶旧图已从画廊移除，并补入第 5 张；答疑改为「已修复」说明
entries.titleEn: Coot: old photo removed, a fifth photo added; note rewritten as a fixed-issue history
entries.bodyZh: 此前那张「雀鹰扑抓白骨顶」的照片只是不再是首图，仍排在画廊第 2 位；现已从素材列表移除，并补入 1 张清晰的白骨顶亲鸟带雏（obs 17125901），恢复为 5 图。答疑不再用「为什么首图看起来不对」的疑问式标题，改为说明来龙去脉与修复结果。
entries.bodyEn: The sparrowhawk-grabbing-a-coot photo had only stopped being the first image; it was still in slot 2 of the gallery. It has now been removed and a clear photo of an adult with chicks (obs 17125901) has been added, restoring the gallery to 5 photos. The note no longer asks “why does the first photo look wrong?” and instead explains what happened and what was fixed.

entries.titleZh: 喜鹊图片更换：停用 3 张、新增 3 张
entries.titleEn: Oriental Magpie photos replaced: 3 retired, 3 added
entries.bodyZh: 有反馈指出喜鹊第 1/3/5 张图不适合识别（不像喜鹊 / 模糊 / 羽色异常）。已停用这三张，补入 3 张新图（iNaturalist，CC0 / CC BY-NC）；现在保留原第 2、4 张 + 新第 6、7、8 张。详见物种答疑。
entries.bodyEn: A report noted that photos #1/#3/#5 of the Oriental Magpie were unsuitable (not a magpie / blurry / atypical plumage). They are retired and replaced with 3 new photos (iNaturalist, CC0 / CC BY-NC); the gallery now keeps original #2 and #4 plus new #6, #7 and #8. See the species note for details.

entries.titleZh: 白骨顶首图已改为策展默认图
entries.titleEn: Coot main photo now uses the curated default
entries.bodyZh: 有反馈指出白骨顶的首图里主体其实是雀鹰。已改为优先使用物种策展默认图（default_photo），并加入人工覆盖表兜底；旧图仍保留在下方其它素材中供对照。
entries.bodyEn: A report noted the coot's main photo actually features a sparrowhawk. We now prefer the species' curated default photo (default_photo) with a manual override fallback; the old photo remains in the gallery for comparison.

entries.titleZh: 新增「大众评审」：反馈可上传并投票
entries.titleEn: Community review: reports can be uploaded and voted
entries.bodyZh: 题目页新增「报错」按钮：可选图片/录音/答案问题并填写你认为的正确答案。反馈会先在本地保存，联网后上传；在「大众评审」页大家可以投票，帮助我们判断并纠正。
entries.bodyEn: A new Report button on quiz questions lets you flag photo/recording/answer issues and suggest the correct answer. Reports are saved locally first, uploaded when online, and everyone can vote on the Review page to help us verify and fix them.
